statement: At the pinned Codex source revision, run_turn repeatedly samples the model, executes requested function calls, feeds results into later samples, accepts steering input, and stops when follow-up work is no longer required or a stop/error path wins.

display_text.zh-CN: 在固定的 Codex 源码版本中，run_turn 会反复采样模型、执行函数调用、把结果送入后续采样并接收 steering；当不再需要 follow-up，或 stop/error 路径生效时结束。
display_text.en: At the pinned Codex source revision, run_turn repeatedly samples the model, executes requested function calls, feeds results into later samples, accepts steering input, and stops when follow-up work is no longer required or a stop/error path wins.

evidence.title: Codex regular task drains queued input

notes: This describes the open-source Rust core at one commit, not every hosted Codex surface or a black-box runtime observation.
